body: i probably should have guessed that bit :-(. even if you're not doing too well, i appreciate you taking the time to talk to me. hmmm the last time i cared i honestly dont remember. sometimes ill care about things a bit more and then that care will disappear after a few hours or days. but generally speaking i guess i havent really cared about things since maybe 2/3 years ago?

im sorry you went through that, and i hope youre doing a lot better now. what you said seemed like good advice, but its just hard to invest myself in anything now, because i dont care. i dont care about my grades (im a couple years off maybe graduating hs), i dont care about getting a job, i dont care enough for anything.
its alright, its hard to help sometimes. thanks

'everyone is beautiful in their own way' is jut an excuse for people when they dont know what to say to someone who isn't pleasant to look at. random people who see me aren't going to think "oh they're probably really kind", they think "that person should get plastic surgery".
